PDF & Office document extractor

Converts a file or a folder to Docling JSON by calling the pdfextractor-cli command line. The conversion runs in the background: documents appear here as they finish, and it can be stopped at any time.

4

Each document that finishes is shown beside the reference for it — its own file, or the file of the same name in the folder — with what agrees, what differs and what only one side has. Where both readings published a box for a block (the PDFs do, the flow formats do not) the boxes take part in the matching: a block the two readings put in the same place is paired with it, two rows that stand in the same place are shown as one row rather than one a side, and a block they put somewhere else is a difference that says where each of them put it.
